observations.title: See action-dependent first-person animations
observations.player_action: Attack, move and manipulate held items with Punchy enabled.
observations.outcome: First-person animation and in-hand motion change the feel of the action without inherently changing its damage contract.
conditions: This is the Punchy first-person animation mod, not the unrelated Punchy color resource pack.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.
